name: custom-laptop-mockup
title: Laptop Mockup
description: An original laptop frame for presenting desktop product screens with a dimensional display, keyboard deck, and replaceable screen content.
useWhen: An original laptop frame for presenting desktop product screens with a dimensional display, keyboard deck, and replaceable screen content.
avoidWhen: Avoid laptop mockup when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Laptop Mockup uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
